query:
UPDATE accounts
               SET featured_collection_url = $2,
                   collections_url = $3,
                   display_name = $4,
                   note = $5,
                   locked = $6,
                   fields = $7,
                   also_known_as = $8,
                   discoverable = $9,
                   indexable = $10,
                   memorial = $11,
                   show_featured = COALESCE($12, show_featured),
                   show_media = COALESCE($13, show_media),
                   show_media_replies = COALESCE($14, show_media_replies),
                   attribution_domains = $15
               WHERE id = $1
